QuestInfo.name: Saving the Townspeople 3
QuestInfo.0: There's trouble with townspeople who got attacked by the kobolds. Talk to #b#p9390450##k.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9390450##k says his son is stuck at #b#m866000120##k! Time to save the day!
QuestInfo.2: You saved Bluffing Tom from the kobolds! What a hero!

0.0: I can't find my son. He's a great kid, really bright, though sometimes he talks too much.
0.1: Can you find him for me? He's probably wandered into the deep parts of the forest. Haha, he always wants to be a hotshot, like his papa. That's me.

no.0: Guess I'll have to look for him myself, unless you change your mind.

1.0: You missed it! I just defeated a gazillion kobolds with my bare fists! It was like, pow pow POP bam!

yes.0: Let's head back to town and let everyone know what we did! I'll include you in my story. I'll say you wiped my brow and fed me sips of water while I fought! \r\n#b(You will be moved to town.)

default.0: Did you find him? It's getting kind of chilly...
